# statuspage_component_group (Resource)

Manages a Statuspage component group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `components` (List of String) List of component IDs in this group.
- `name` (String) Display name for the component group.
- `page_id` (String) Page identifier.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the component group.
- `position` (Number) Order the component group will appear on the page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Component group identifier.
